text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Since Sweep Tosho wasn't feeling well,
I decided to let her rest in the infirmary...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You're just as much of a worrywart as my dad!
Fine, I'll take a rest.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Come along, familiar!
Next is Summoning class♪ We have to hurry!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? Familiar?
Why aren't you answering...?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, w-what is this!?
There are so many familiarsーー!?

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep, you're doing so great working hard today!
I'm gonna get you an amazing reward!"

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text:
"Sweep, you're doing so well working hard today!
I'll make sure to get you a wonderful reward!"

text_block_list.name: Familiar? B
text_block_list.text:
"Don't be fooled, Sweep!
You don't need this kind of pampering for training!"

text_block_list.name: Familiar? B
text_block_list.text:
"Don't let them trick you, Sweep!
You don't need this kind of pampering for training!"

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, time to train instead of magic class!"
"Feels like inspiration will strike again today!"
"Sweep, amazing, genius!"

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
"Come on, time to train instead of magic class!"
"Feels like inspiration will strike again today!"
"Sweep, amazing, genius!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Shut your mouth!
Where did you take the real familiar?!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text: "'The real deal is right here! Now, as your reward—'"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Shut uuuup!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
That's *my* familiar! Don't be ridiculous!
I can at least tell it apart from some common small fry!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
First off, you! What part of you is the real one?!
My familiar doesn't baby me in such a clingy way!

text_block_list.name: Familiar? A
text_block_list.text: "Gyahii--!!"

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Not you, not you, and not you either!
A familiar doesn't force people to obey them!
They don't disrespect magic! And they talk differently too!

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
"Did they figure it out!?"
"Guh... damn it!"
"Witch, magic, amazing."

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: *Yawn*... Oh, there's the real one!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You're a handful even in my dreams!
Still as useless a familiar as ever!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Upon waking up, Sweep Tosho looked
somehow a little proud of herself.
It seems she's gotten her groove back...!"

text_block_list.name: Familiars?
text_block_list.text:
“As expected of Sweep!”
“More importantly, let's get training!”
“You. Are. Amazing. Genius.”

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on!
Don't crowd me!! I'm gonna get squished—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Familiaaaar!!!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Geez~~~!! If you're gonna show up in my dreams, show up properly! I've got a bone to pick with you!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A furious Sweep Tosho came barging into
the trainer's office for some reason...
Apparently, a strange dream kept her from sleeping well.
